02Workshops

Four experiential journeys for curious minds.

Hands-on sessions for teachers, students and teams, built on attention, creative cognition and collaboration. Each one can be adapted to your context, age group and time.

1

Alternating Attention as a Catalyst for a Creative-Cerebral Educational Perspective

Participants play through an alternate scenario where creative cognition, play, sense-making and collaboration meet. Transdisciplinary materials, systemic thinking and a facilitating card deck train deliberate attention-shifting and metacognitive awareness, building the cognitive and temporal flexibility that creative learning depends on.

  • Attention
  • Metacognition
  • Card deck
2

Idea Bouncing: Building the Future through Vibrational LEGOciation

Language, communication and creative cognition in practice. Through linguistic interaction, collaborative problem-solving and deliberate attention-shifting, groups talk, build in LEGO and rebuild, turning abstract ideas into tangible outcomes and seeing first-hand how dialogue mediates creativity and learning design.

  • LEGOciation
  • Collaboration
  • Language
3

The Thinking Journey

Students explore how the brain works while building critical thinking. In Shape Your Brain they picture neural growth as a response to challenge; in LEGOciation at the Station they rotate through thematic stations of dialogue and LEGO construction, closing with a shared reflection on what high-quality thinking looks like.

  • Students
  • Neuroplasticity
  • Critical thinking
4

The Creative Mindset Journey

Growth mindset meets creative thinking for future and practising teachers. Creativity and neuroplasticity in theory, then Random Word, Random Picture, Reverse Brainstorming and Six Thinking Hats in practice, so participants leave with more confidence, engagement and enthusiasm for creative strategies in their own teaching.

  • Growth mindset
  • Creative methods
  • Teachers
